title: Environmental Resource Management, B.S. — Environmental Science Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Environmental Science Option, University Park (of three options: Environmental Science, Soil Science, Water Science -- Environmental Science chosen since it has the most concrete course codes; Soil Science's second year involves an ambiguous 'AGRO 28/HORT 101/TURF 235/BIOL 220W/FOR 203' 5-way pool with two departments (TURF, FOR) not yet in any catalog). Handbook cross-check (Ecosystem Science and Management department, bulletin-only for ERM specifically -- no distinct ERM department handbook found, only WFS and Forest Ecosystem Management publish their own): the 'ASM 327' item was a wrong/synthetic code -- Penn State's real course is ABSM 327 (Soil and Water Resource Management, Dept. of Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management), confirmed against the live bulletin's own curriculum table and the ABSM course-description page (which does NOT 404 -- the earlier 404 was from guessing the wrong department prefix, ASM instead of ABSM). Fixed to ABSM 327 (real 'Enforced Concurrent at Enrollment: PHYS 250 or PHYS 211', already satisfied since PHYS 250/211 is scheduled Semester 4, before ABSM 327's Semester 5); swapped ASM->ABSM in departments and dropped the orphaned asm_catalog.json placeholder from use. 'CED 201' requires 'ERM 300' as a same-term-or-earlier concurrent requirement -- both are scheduled in Semester 6, with ERM 300 listed first. Real enumerated lists found on the live bulletin for 'Ecology Selection' (BIOL 415/436/444/446/448/450W/463/482/499A, ERM 430/431/435/450, HORT 445, SOILS 412W, WFS 422/430/466) and 'Communications/Sustainability/Leadership' (AEE 360/440, CAS 213/214/250/352, CIVCM 211, ERM 402/499, MGMT 215, SUST 200) -- wired via the engine's 'match' field (credits toward the requirement when a student has already taken one, and a recommendation-score boost, same treatment as CMPSC's curated technical-elective category; these lists span departments not all loaded in this plan, so they don't feed the active semester-by-semester auto-fill). '400-Level ERM Course' (x2, bulletin: 'select 6 credits total from any 400-level ERM offerings' -- genuinely open-ended) and the 18-credit adviser-selected 'Specialization/Minor' pool (6 items x 3cr, bulletin: no enumerated list published) remain modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools -- confirmed correct via live bulletin re-check, not just carried forward. Post-scraper-fix repair: CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22 and STAT 200's real prereq is MATH 21, neither of which were in this plan at all -- and MATH 22/21 themselves real-chain through MATH 4 and MATH 3, also missing. Added all four (MATH 3, MATH 4, MATH 21, MATH 22); confirmed clean (no warnings, goal met) after the addition, but only once max_credits_per_semester was also bumped from 17 to 18 (matching the convention most other majors this session already use) -- at 17cr/semester the extra 12 real credits didn't fit in 8 terms even though no single prereq chain was individually too deep, just aggregate credit capacity.
